import re

CONFLICT = re.compile(r"^(?P<file>[^:\s]+): (?P<level>warning|error): (?P<kind>shift/reduce|reduce/reduce) conflict on token (?P<token>\S+) \[(?P<flag>-W[\w-]+)\]$")
DIAG = re.compile(r"^(?P<file>[^:\s]+): (?P<level>warning|error|note): (?P<message>\S.*?)(?: \[(?P<flag>-W[\w-]+)\])?$")
EXAMPLE = re.compile(r"^\s+(?P<label>\S.*?[Ee]xample): (?P<example>\S.*)$")
DERIV = re.compile(r"^\s+(?P<label>\S.*?) derivation$")
NODE = re.compile(r"^(?P<indent>\s*)(?:`-> (?P<rule>\d+): )?(?P<production>\S.*?)\s*$")


def parse(lines):
    conflicts, diags, nodes = [], [], []
    c_lines, d_lines, n_lines = [], [], []
    cur, deriv, stack = None, None, []
    for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        m = CONFLICT.match(ln)
        if m:
            cur = m.groupdict()
            cur["conflict"] = len(conflicts) + 1
            conflicts.append(cur)
            c_lines.append(j)
            deriv = None
            continue
        m = DIAG.match(ln)
        if m:
            cur, deriv = None, None
            diags.append({k: v or "" for k, v in m.groupdict().items()})
            d_lines.append(j)
            continue
        if cur is None:
            continue
        m = EXAMPLE.match(ln)
        if m:
            cur[m.group("label").lower().replace(" ", "_")] = m.group("example")
            c_lines.append(j)
            continue
        m = DERIV.match(ln)
        if m:
            deriv, stack = m.group("label"), []
            n_lines.append(j)
            continue
        m = NODE.match(ln)
        if deriv and m:
            indent = len(m.group("indent"))
            if m.group("rule") is None:
                depth, stack = 0, [indent - 1]
            else:
                while stack and stack[-1] >= indent:
                    stack.pop()
                depth = len(stack)
                stack.append(indent)
            nodes.append({"conflict": cur["conflict"], "token": cur["token"], "derivation": deriv,
                          "depth": depth, "rule": m.group("rule") or "", "production": m.group("production")})
            n_lines.append(j)
    keys = ["conflict", "file", "level", "kind", "token", "flag"]
    for c in conflicts:
        for k in c:
            if k not in keys:
                keys.append(k)
    conflicts = [{k: c.get(k, "") for k in keys} for c in conflicts]
    return [{"name": "conflicts", "kind": "table", "lines": c_lines, "records": conflicts},
            {"name": "derivations", "kind": "table", "lines": n_lines, "records": nodes},
            {"name": "diagnostics", "kind": "table", "lines": d_lines, "records": diags}]
